title: Notes on building LLM agents that don't fall over
summary: Agents fail in boring, predictable ways: unbounded loops, malformed tool calls, and silent drift. A few patterns that make them sturdier, with a minimal Python loop.

title: Stoicism and the art of debugging
summary: The dichotomy of control, the view from above, and premeditatio malorum — three Stoic ideas that turned out to be excellent debugging tools.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow, read by an engineer
summary: Kahneman's System 1 and System 2 map uncomfortably well onto how we build, evaluate and trust machine learning systems — and onto how I make decisions at work.

title: Why I'm starting this blog
summary: Writing is how I find out what I actually think. Here's what this blog is for, what I'll write about, and what I won't pretend to know.
